newsitem.title: USA: BDM Int'l wins two contracts from Texas.
newsitem.headline: BDM Int'l wins two contracts from Texas.

text.p: BDM International Inc said Friday it won two information technology services contracts from Texas.
The first contract, worth $8.2 million over two and a half years, is for streamlining and rewriting the benefits systems for the Texas Teachers Retirement System.
The second contract, valued at $400,000 to $500,000, is a four-month study for the Texas Comptroller's Office to examine statewide human resource and payroll activities.
BDM provides information technology systems and services to public and commercial customers.
